# Carbon Energy Nexus

> A free daily publication at carbonenergynexus.com on where carbon, energy, water and capital meet: CO2 capture and storage, carbon markets and removals, energy policy, produced water and the water footprint of energy, project finance and research. Each edition sorts news by electrons (power), molecules (fuels), pore space (the subsurface) and water, tracks projects on a seven step ladder from announcement to operation, and says what each story means for investors, regulators, industry and founders. Facts are sourced and dated; stages and outlooks are labeled as our judgment. General information, not investment advice.

## Tools
- [Energy and carbon footprint calculator](https://carbonenergynexus.com/calculator.html): households and companies, EPA and EIA factors, transparent Nexus Score
- [Frameworks](https://carbonenergynexus.com/frameworks.html): how projects, policy and carbon claims are judged

## Today's edition
- [IEA raises its 2050 carbon removal need by 30% as operating capture capacity sits at 68 Mt a year](https://carbonenergynexus.com/): November 27, 2026. 30% more carbon removal by 2050: that is the IEA's new net zero need, with 6.4 billion tonnes of CO2 captured a year against 68 million tonnes of capacity running today.
- [Capital: Australia sets a record for renewable investment decisions as big battery commitments double](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#money)
- [Projects: China commissions a 195 km pipeline built only for hydrogen in Inner Mongolia](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#world)
- [Regulation: UK cement and lime makers and unions sign a charter asking for carbon capture certainty](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#policy)
- [Water: Nevada study says data centers could use 4 billion gallons of water a year by 2036](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#water)
- [Projects: India and The Gambia add battery storage: L&T wins 900 MWh at Khavda, NVVN seeks 750 MWh](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#storage)
